deferred.claim: Cast Spider-Sense at its printed mana cost to counter an instant spell, sorcery spell, or triggered ability.
deferred.basis: Counter target instant spell, sorcery spell, or triggered ability.

deferred.claim: Cast Spider-Sense for its web-slinging alternative cost, paying {U} and returning a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand, to counter an instant spell, sorcery spell, or triggered ability.
deferred.basis: Web-slinging {U} (You may cast this spell for {U} if you also return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.) ... Counter target instant spell, sorcery spell, or triggered ability.
